budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Two teams carry their finite native packets to the opposing base. Deliveries reward both teammates and penalize the opposing team; tagging, sensing and covering can alter the race.
task.natural_termination: Both packets have been delivered; otherwise horizon 112 ends the contest. Either zero or one delivery at the horizon remains a valid outcome.
task.interaction: Packets can be picked up, handed off, dropped by simultaneous tags and recovered. Two sensing charges per actor fund warmup scanners or local decoy-jammer cover. Partner radio reports are sampled from the preceding state on even clocks, with explicit age; they do not grant current teammate visibility.
task.observation_access: Current entities are visible within Manhattan radius 2 or a same-team active scanner's radius 4. Enemy-team agents, packets and scanners inside their own decoy's radius 2 resist remote scanning but remain locally visible. Decoy transmitters remain detectable by remote scans. Same-team transmitters are team-known. Walls block motion, not radial sensing. Inactive objects are hidden. Reports are visible only to their recipient; only own charge is observed. Map, bases, delivery announcements and scores are public. Raw full state is privileged audit data, never a role-view HUD.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Public base announcement: this team's packet arrived this transition

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
